en.answer: In that case, the targeted monster cannot be destroyed, and the Special Summon of <<11244>> is not performed.
en.question: If at the time of the resolution of the effect of <<11244>> that Special Summons itself from the Graveyard the targeted monster is no longer on the field, so that it cannot be destroyed, how does the effect resolve?
